cases.sentence: Кто поверил слышанному от нас, и кому открылась мышца ___?
cases.explain: The possessive phrase 'мышца Господа' (arm of the Lord) uses the genitive case to show possession.

cases.sentence: Не было в нем ни красы, ни величия, чтобы нам смотреть на него. Не было в его облике ничего, что привлекло бы нас. Он был презрен и отвергнут ___, человек скорбей, знакомый с недугом.
cases.explain: The preposition от with быть отвергнут (to be rejected by) takes the instrumental case in this construction.

cases.sentence: Но он взял на себя наши немощи и понес наши ___.
cases.explain: The verb понес (carried) takes the accusative case for its direct object скорби (sorrows).

cases.sentence: Мы же думали, разит его Бог за ____ его.
cases.explain: The preposition за (for) in this context takes the accusative case with the plural грехи.

cases.sentence: Но он был изранен за наши грехи, сокрушаем за наши ___. Он понес наказание, чтобы мы получили мир, и ранами его мы исцелились.
cases.explain: The preposition за (for) takes the accusative case, so беззаконие becomes беззакония in plural accusative.

cases.sentence: Все мы, как овцы, сбились с пути, каждый из нас пошел своей дорогой. Но на него Господь возложил все ___ наши.
cases.explain: The verb возложил (laid upon) takes the accusative case for the direct object грехи (sins).

cases.sentence: Он был угнетаем и мучим, но уст своих не открывал. Как ___ он был веден на заклание, и как овца перед стригущими безмолвно, так и он не открывал уст своих.
cases.explain: Ягненок is used in a simile (like a lamb) and is the subject of implied comparison, taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Через познание его мой праведный слуга многих оправдает и понесет их ___. Поэтому я дам ему удел с великими, и добычу разделит он с сильными.
cases.explain: The verb понесет (will bear) takes the accusative case for its direct object грехи (sins).

reading.ru: Кто поверил слышанному от нас, и кому открылась мышца Господня?
reading.question: What is the question asked about belief in this verse?
options: Who has believed the message, and to whom has the Lord's arm been revealed?
Who can see God face to face?
How many followers do we have?
What day of the week is it?
reading.correct: Who has believed the message, and to whom has the Lord's arm been revealed?
reading.explain: The verse directly asks 'Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh's arm been revealed?'

reading.ru: Он был презрен и отвергнут людьми, человек скорбей, знакомый с недугом.
reading.question: How is the suffering servant described in this verse?
options: Despised, rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease
Honored, loved by all people, and in perfect health
Joyful and always surrounded by friends
reading.correct: Despised, rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease
reading.explain: The verse says 'He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease.'

reading.ru: Но он взял на себя наши немощи и понес наши скорби.
reading.question: What did the servant do for us?
options: He bore our sickness and carried our sorrows
He asked us to help him
He condemned us for our weaknesses
reading.correct: He bore our sickness and carried our sorrows
reading.explain: The passage states 'he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering.'

reading.ru: Все мы, как овцы, сбились с пути, каждый из нас пошел своей дорогой.
reading.question: What is compared to sheep in this verse, and what have they done?
options: All of us like sheep have gone astray, everyone turned to his own way
We are like shepherds guiding the flock
We have all stayed on the right path
reading.correct: All of us like sheep have gone astray, everyone turned to his own way
reading.explain: The verse says 'All we like sheep have gone astray; every one has turned to his own way.'

reading.ru: Он был угнетаем и мучим, но уст своих не открывал.
reading.question: How did the servant respond to oppression and affliction?
options: He did not open his mouth
He cried out loudly for help
reading.correct: He did not open his mouth
reading.explain: The text states 'He was oppressed and afflicted, yet when he was afflicted he didn't open his mouth.'

reading.ru: После страданий своих он увидит свет и порадуется.
reading.question: What will the servant experience after his sufferings?
options: He will see the light and be satisfied
He will suffer eternally without end
reading.correct: He will see the light and be satisfied
reading.explain: The verse promises 'After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied.'
